cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Test the Story First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to repeat the explanation, ask the dangerous question, or test the risky step before you commit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've turned your page over, so I've turned my accounts over. Anonymous questions, good. Ask the chair whether a banking delay explains the missing raffle money before I sign.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm using the blank side for sums. I'm not defending your accounts again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Room for calculations, yes. Just ask her whether a banking delay is plausible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say you're testing a hypothetical. If she wants a name, come back before giving mine.
